# TopologicalEquilibriumPoint

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A stable configuration of network topology and node states that resists perturbation, analogous to an attractor in dynamical systems. Enables prediction of long-term behavior in TCC systems, guiding topology optimization for desired collective outcomes.
